title: Application of single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of novel breast cancer phenotypes based on the activation of ferroptosis-related genes.
authors: Liu, Shuochuan; Zhao, Yajie; Zhang, Jiao; Liu, Zhenzhen
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于铁死亡相关基因构建乳腺癌分型模型，虽涉及转录因子激活状态分析，但核心为临床预后与肿瘤微环境，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ferroptosis is distinct from classic apoptotic cell death characterized by the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and lipid peroxides on the cell membrane. Increasing findings have demonstrated that ferroptosis plays an important role in cancer development, but the exploration of ferroptosis in breast cancer is limited. In our study, we aimed to establish a ferroptosis activation-related model based on the differentially expressed genes between a group exhibiting high ferroptosis activation and a group exhibiting low ferroptosis activation. By using machine learning to establish the model, we verified the accuracy and efficiency of our model in The Cancer Genome Atlas Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA-BRCA) set and gene expression omnibus (GEO) dataset. Additionally, our research innovatively utilized single-cell RNA sequencing data to systematically reveal the microenvironment in the high and low FeAS groups, which demonstrated differences between the two groups from comprehensive aspects, including the activation condition of transcription factors, cell pseudotime features, cell communication, immune infiltration, chemotherapy efficiency, and potential drug resistance. In conclusion, different ferroptosis activation levels play a vital role in influencing the outcome of breast cancer patients and altering the tumor microenvironment in different molecular aspects. By analyzing differences in ferroptosis activation levels, our risk model is characterized by a good prognostic capacity in assessing the outcome of breast cancer patients, and the risk score can be used to prompt clinical treatment to prevent potential drug resistance. By identifying the different tumor microenvironment landscapes between the high- and low-risk groups, our risk model provides molecular insight into ferroptosis in breast cancer patients.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）与经典的凋亡性细胞死亡不同，其特征是细胞膜上活性氧（ROS）和脂质过氧化物的积累。越来越多的研究发现，铁死亡在癌症发展中扮演重要角色，但在乳腺癌中对铁死亡的探索仍有限。在本研究中，我们旨在基于高铁死亡激活组与低铁死亡激活组之间的差异表达基因，建立一个铁死亡激活相关模型。通过使用机器学习构建该模型，我们在癌症基因组图谱乳腺浸润癌（TCGA-BRCA）数据集和基因表达综合（GEO）数据集中验证了模型的准确性和效率。此外，我们的研究创新性地利用单细胞RNA测序数据，系统揭示了高铁死亡激活组和低铁死亡激活组中的微环境，从多个方面展示了两组之间的差异，包括转录因子的激活状态、细胞伪时间特征、细胞通讯、免疫浸润、化疗效率及潜在耐药性。总之，不同的铁死亡激活水平在影响乳腺癌患者预后和从不同分子层面改变肿瘤微环境中发挥关键作用。通过分析铁死亡激活水平的差异，我们的风险模型在评估乳腺癌患者预后方面表现出良好的预测能力，且风险评分可用于指导临床治疗以预防潜在耐药性。通过识别高风险组和低风险组之间不同的肿瘤微环境景观，我们的风险模型为乳腺癌患者中的铁死亡提供了分子层面的见解。
